data.name: Anjar
data.gender_notes: Anjar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anjar is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'An' (meaning 'up' or 'support') and 'Jar' (meaning 'God'). The name signifies the divine support and strength that a child may receive in their life. The name Anjar carries the meaning “God's support” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anjar usually hope their child will grow to embody god's support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anjar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anjar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
